title: 🔆🔅Ashgabat, November 2 — Iran’s Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi made remarks in an interview during his trip to Turkmenistan.
text:
🔆🔅Ashgabat, November 2 — Iran’s Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi made remarks in an interview during his trip to Turkmenistan."

""
"-------"

"SOT1, Abbas Araghchi, Iran’s Foreign Minister (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:41): "We have said over and over that just as we are fully prepared to defend ourselves, we are also prepared to enter the diplomatic arena and find a negotiated solution. We have stated our conditions and presented our plan; it now depends on how much political rationality exists on the American side and whether they are prepared to take the wise path, the path of diplomacy and negotiation, or whether they want to move toward military operations, as in the past. We are prepared for both, and we are better prepared for both than we were before.""

"SOT2, Abbas Araghchi, Iran’s Foreign Minister (Farsi) (00:42 - 01:34): "If they wish to test us once again, they themselves know that the result will be worse than in the past. If they are prepared to engage in diplomacy in good faith, we remain ready; the situation is clear. We have certain conditions for the opening of the Strait of Hormuz; if they accept these conditions, the Strait of Hormuz will be opened and negotiations will be resumed. If they do not accept them, then the situation remains as it is. As for our positions, which are principled positions, it is natural that we will not back down. We will not bow to these powers, but we are rational people; we are people of negotiation and dialogue, and we are prepared to engage in positive interaction if our counterpart possesses such qualities.
